description: Land Acquisition - Ihala Millewa North and Pahala Millewa South, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Millewa, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and claimants. The document is an official order for taking possession of lands, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisitions and property matters. While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the land acquisition action being authorized, not the primary focus of the content.
